description: Validates the experimental framework by shuffling temporal order of audio features within each utterance for Condition A (SSL). Time-shuffled features should produce degraded LVE compared to temporally ordered features.
verdict_rationale: Time-shuffled LVE (1.033e-05) is 14.9% worse than normal LVE (9.00e-06) and 32.6% worse than constant-motion baseline (7.79e-06). The shuffled model produces worse lip animation than simply predicting the mean face, confirming that the decoder genuinely exploits temporal structure from the audio frontend rather than relying on speaker identity or static features.
